question: us-policy-positions:justice-public-safety.end-cash-bail
definition: yes = state law has ended or nearly ended money bail as a condition of pretrial release (release decided by risk and conditions, with detention hearings instead of money); no = money bail remains a standard, lawful pretrial release condition statewide.
summarySource: Stateline 9/23/2025 and Stanford Law 10/2/2025 national overviews; Illinois 725 ILCS 5/110; N.J.S.A. 2A:162-15 (Justia 2025); D.C. Code § 23-1321 (Justia 2025); Brennan Center (NY); Ballotpedia (NM 2016, CA Prop 25).

US-AL.note: Money bail remains a standard, lawful pretrial release condition statewide; national surveys list Illinois as the only state to abolish it and New Jersey and D.C. as near-abolition systems.

US-AK.note: HB 49 (signed 7/8/2019) repealed SB 91's risk-assessment release presumption and the clear-and-convincing finding before monetary bail.
